inputs: Publisher.contract from a synthetic GitLab protocol fixture
registered phase-one source schema and source SQL
generic business request: understand sales performance over time
environment_issue: Default Python outside the repository lacked SQLGlot; the existing repository .venv interpreter ran the unchanged adapter.
semantic_assessment: Business proposals identify stakeholders, commercial decisions, time attribution, population and price policies. They are not only source-quality observations.
policy_difference: The fresh proposal preserves calculation precision until aggregation and rounds displayed totals; the working pilot retains an unconfirmed per-line settlement-rounding proposal. Neither policy is approved.
limitations: One conversation-level isolation trial, not an OS sandbox
Synthetic transport, not deployed GitLab acceptance
No metric execution or business confirmation
No claim that every clean agent will reproduce this proposal
Trial namespace is separate from the production registry; do not promote its identities blindly
